scope: document only: axis names, inputs, outputs, clocks and label availability so later specs can be frozen one at a time; no execution cadence, threshold, operation, call, fit or online update is implied or authorized; Fly delta-rule updates are training and sit under the same scope control as fits

clocks_per_record.market_as_of: the last completed KR session D whose data the record uses (session date)
clocks_per_record.decision_at: the logical moment the output is produced for: the close of D; a record may also carry decision_not_before = market_as_of close + confirmation lag
clocks_per_record.input_available_at: the time the inputs were actually available: for genuine point-in-time records this must be <= decision_at; for replayed history it is the fetch time of the file used
clocks_per_record.produced_at: wall-clock UTC when the record was computed
clocks_per_record.vintage_mode: point_in_time (inputs were available at decision_at, with provenance proving it) or retrospective_latest_vintage (history fetched later; such records never claim that the data was available at decision_at)
clocks_per_record.completion_rule: a KR daily bar for D is treated as complete when fetched_at >= D 15:31:00+09:00; this is a declared regular-session fallback assumption, not exchange or provider confirmation (special sessions have other close times); when a known-at-time calendar or provider finality flag is available it takes precedence and is recorded as the completion source

label_availability_per_target.rule: each target declares label_start_at, label_end_at and label_available_at; a component may update with a label only after label_available_at, and evaluation splits purge every record whose label_available_at exceeds the split boundary; there is no single shared maturity clock

B_teacher_20.label_available_at: when the D+21 opening price is observable
B_teacher_20.definition: z(D,0), z(D,1) as in the frozen B teacher

E_close20.label_available_at: when the D+20 close is complete (completion rule above)
E_close20.definition: event iff min over s in D+1..D+20 of C_s / C_D - 1 <= -0.05; the primary and only forward endpoint of the first research phase; a declared research endpoint, not a validated exit threshold

E_peak20_future_alternative.definition: event iff min over s in D+1..D+20 of (C_s / max over u in D..s of C_u - 1) <= -0.05, i.e. the largest drawdown magnitude inside the window >= 5%; corrected from v1 (v1 used max, which selected the shallowest drawdown: closes 100,96,94,97 give drawdowns -4%,-6%,-3%; v1 max = -3% -> no event, correct min = -6% -> event)
E_peak20_future_alternative.status: retained as a future alternative; not selected alongside E_close20 and never chosen after seeing results

S_generated_state_at_D.label_available_at: n/a: training-only metadata of generated paths (hidden regime at D); exists only for generated paths, is never an inference input and is never a real-market label

fields: value_type (scalar_score | probability_vector | label | ranked_records | fraction | abstain)
target_id (one of the label_availability_per_target ids, or null for state)
confidence_basis (sample count | agreement | past calibration | none)
provenance (input file paths and sha256, fetched_at per file, calendar/completion source, code sha256, model/encoder version and sha256)
rules: scores and probabilities are never relabelled as each other
a component that cannot produce an output abstains explicitly with a reason instead of emitting a default
state outputs and forward-risk outputs are separate axis ids and never share a calibration claim

B_direction.question: at the close of D, which cost-inclusive one-share action value is higher over the next 20 sessions (held 0: buy vs cash; held 1: keep vs sell)?
B_direction.inputs: the frozen 6 features at D (5 price features from adjusted closes <= D, held)
B_direction.model: frozen yearly B fits of result 0b10b9da, each applied only in its own execution year

T_state.question: at the close of D, which generated-regime state does the current pattern resemble: down / up / neutral?
T_state.inputs: numeric feature vector V_D = 5 frozen price features + logret120 + 20-session log-price slope + drawdown from the 60-session rolling peak + down-closes in the last 10 sessions + sd60/sd20, all from closes <= D
T_state.calibration_status: uncalibrated for real markets; may be reported as calibrated_on:generated check/test paths only, never against E_close20
T_state.semantics: generated-state resemblance under the declared mapping down={descent,crash}, up={ascent,rebound}, neutral={sideways,highvol}; not a real-market trend truth

T_forward_risk.question: at the close of D, will E_close20 occur?
T_forward_risk.value_type: scalar_score or probability with explicit calibration_status
T_forward_risk.learner: to be fixed in its own spec; no real-label fitting before that spec

F1_fly_state.question: same as T_state
F1_fly_state.inputs: V_D -> frozen scaler (train-prefix statistics) -> fixed random projection -> connectome PN->KC -> top-k code z_D; readout head for state
F1_fly_state.comparability: same V_D and same target as T_state

F1_fly_forward_risk.question: same as T_forward_risk
F1_fly_forward_risk.inputs: z_D as above; a separate readout head
F1_fly_forward_risk.calibration_status: uncalibrated unless a nested calibration set is declared
F1_fly_forward_risk.learning: delta-rule updates only after label_available_at of E_close20; every update is training and is logged with decision_at and label_available_at; the current avoid weights and the 7-panel-row horizon are not transplanted
F1_fly_forward_risk.controls: degree/weight-matched rewired Fly, frozen (no-learning) Fly, native-feature logistic baseline on V_D with the same target and budget; seeds predeclared
F1_fly_forward_risk.comparability: same V_D and same target as T_forward_risk

F2_fly_similar_cases.question: which earlier sessions had the most similar sparse code to D, and what happened after them?
F2_fly_similar_cases.encoder_version: scaler and projection and theta frozen on a declared training prefix; version id = sha256 of (scaler statistics, projection seed, theta snapshot, connectome file sha); the query code and every candidate code are computed with the same version; a later encoder change creates a new version and a new code cache before any scoring; codes of different versions are never compared
F2_fly_similar_cases.candidates: sessions s with label_available_at(E_close20 at s) <= decision_at of D, i.e. the D+20 close of s is complete before D's close (s <= D - 20 under the regular calendar)
F2_fly_similar_cases.selection: rank candidates by cosine similarity of codes, tie-break by deterministic session id order; greedily accept a candidate only if its anchor is >= 21 asset sessions from every accepted anchor (closed outcome windows [s, s+20] do not overlap); stop at k = 10; return fewer if insufficient
F2_fly_similar_cases.value_type: ranked_records of {session s, similarity, 20-session return C_{s+20}/C_s - 1, largest drawdown magnitude in (s, s+20], E_close20 label at s, label_available_at}
F2_fly_similar_cases.also_returned: candidate_count, returned_count, similarity spread, encoder_version, remaining dependence on the input window
F2_fly_similar_cases.calibration_status: n/a; k and similarity are not confidence
F2_fly_similar_cases.use: evidence shown to Jev stage 2 (later) and to the owner as dated examples; no decision change in phase 1

R_feasibility_rules.question: given a target weight and a next-open input, what integer quantity is affordable with costs, and which position rules fire?
R_feasibility_rules.inputs: account state with its own input_available_at, next-open input with observed_at, frozen rule parameters
R_feasibility_rules.value_type: ranked_records (computed quantity, fired rules with their inputs)
R_feasibility_rules.implementation: dobby_kr_core_v1 quantity() for sizing; rules as explicit predicates; the bill.py guard remains in the execution layer and judges book conditions only; outputs are computations, not orders

J_jev_blind_stage1.inputs: a dated daily chart image of sessions D-119..D rendered from completed bars only (close, MA20, MA200, volume) and plain facts: last close, 5/20/60-session returns, drawdown from the 60-session peak; no outputs of other axes, no account state
J_jev_blind_stage1.question: 1) is the current trend down, up or unclear? 2) conditional preference for the next 20 sessions: long, cash or unclear (there is no position in this question); 3) horizon you have in mind; 4) one-line reason; 5) stated confidence low/medium/high
J_jev_blind_stage1.calibration_status: uncalibrated; the stated confidence is not an outcome probability
J_jev_blind_stage1.optional_action_form: if action labels are wanted later, ask held=0 and held=1 as two separate questions
J_jev_blind_stage1.stage_2: deferred to a separately scoped comparison; no calls in this phase

aggregate.phase_1: none; each axis is recorded and scored separately against its own target with its own label availability
aggregate.phase_2: one aggregate formula is predeclared and frozen before any test; only then are frozen ablations (B-only, leave-one-expert-out) run; the aggregate is never selected on test gains

evaluation_phase_1_axis_wise.state_axes: T_state and F1_fly_state against S_generated_state on generated check/test paths only; confusion matrices; no real-market claim
evaluation_phase_1_axis_wise.forward_axes: T_forward_risk, F1_fly_forward_risk and the logistic baseline against E_close20 on real sessions: precision/recall/false alarms at predeclared operating points, log-loss and Brier only where probabilities are claimed, detection delay and warning persistence; yearly blocks
evaluation_phase_1_axis_wise.retrieval_axis: F2: for each D, the outcome distribution of returned cases vs the realized E_close20 at D; coverage statistics; near-duplicate audit
evaluation_phase_1_axis_wise.jev_axis: stage-1 labels vs realized E_close20 and vs 20-session return sign; agreement with T/F1 recorded but not used
evaluation_phase_1_axis_wise.uncertainty: chronological block summaries; no independent-row intervals on overlapping windows
evaluation_phase_1_axis_wise.selection: no winner selection on test; seeds and operating points predeclared

explicitly_not_in_this_document: transplant of current Fly avoid weights
code, fits, online updates, Jev or API calls
open_for_bill: the training prefix for the frozen F2 encoder version (drafted: sessions <= 2014-12-30, the first B cutoff)
whether T_forward_risk and F1_fly_forward_risk use identical seeds per control pair
the exact feature definitions of the five added V_D items (window edges), to be frozen in the T/F1 spec
